title: finding(types): the published `ViewNavigationConfig` docblock teaches `navigation: { view: 'summary_view' }` as legal authored metadata — the key ADR-0049 retired in spec 17.5.0, which types `never` on the bump
body:
`packages/types/src/objectql.ts:2546`, seat-verified at source on `origin/main` **00c4df509**. The docblock of the published `ViewNavigationConfig` alias tells an author, in these words:

> So `navigation: { view: 'summary_view' }` is legal authored metadata that lets the mode default, and the hand copy refused it.

⇒ ⭐ **that sentence is the trap.** `view.list.navigation.view` was **removed** in `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 under ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove). On the bump, that key types `never` and a parse raises the tombstone — so a doc comment on a **published type** is teaching the exact spelling the runtime will refuse. Control from the same command: `navigation` occurs on **26** lines of that file, so the instrument reads it and this is one line of many, ⛔ not a whole-file claim.

## Why class (c) and ⛔ not (a)

The sentence was **true when written** — it is about `mode` being optional, and it uses `view` only as the carrier. Nothing is broken today, because this repo still resolves the **published** spec 17.4.0, where the key exists. ⇒ this is ⛔ not a reproducible defect; it is a published doc comment that steers whoever writes metadata — very often an AI reading the type's own docs — toward a key that will be **rejected or silently dropped** by the runtime it is authored against.

## The population, re-measured by this seat in one command (⛔ not inherited)

The same spelling is **authored** at five more sites in three files, each of which types `never` on the bump — printed, not counted:

```
packages/types/src/__tests__/gantt-declared-keys.test.ts:117   navigation: { mode: 'page' as const, view: 'task_detail', openNewTab: false },
packages/types/src/__tests__/gantt-declared-keys.test.ts:191   navigation: { mode: 'page', view: 'task_detail', openNewTab: false },
packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts:386   navigation: { mode: 'drawer', view: 'summary_view' },
packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.ganttNavigationForward-7334.test.tsx:183   navigation: { mode: 'split', view: 'leave_summary', size: 'lg' },
packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.ganttNavigationForward-7334.test.tsx:185   expect(node.navigation).toEqual({ mode: 'split', view: 'leave_summary', size: 'lg' });
```

⚠️ Those five are **test** sites and are recorded on objectui#9667 (the sibling card) rather than here — ⛔ this card is the **published doc comment**, which is the only one of the set an author reads.
